description: This file defines the 'EcuInitCallback' interface in Java, which declares a callback method for EcuInit objects within the ECU communication query package of the RomRaider project.

classes.name: EcuInitCallback
classes.description: An interface that declares a callback method to handle 'EcuInit' objects during ECU communication initialization.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Defines a callback method that accepts an 'EcuInit' object, intended to be implemented by classes to handle ECU initialization events.
